decisions.label: Over the house
decisions.note: On: every piece drawn over the house's floors, walls and crown, still behind what's solid in front of her (the decks). Off: under them, as before. Replay it: E (the pad's square) at her decks once the party's on.

decisions.label: Sparkles
decisions.note: The burst of amber and rose sparkles round her.

decisions.label: Sparkles: how many
decisions.note: 64 before.

decisions.label: Sparkles: size
decisions.note: On screen, in pixels (5 before, a plain square); from 3 up a little plus-shaped star.

decisions.label: Sparkles: brightness
decisions.note: How bright each starts, fading out over its life (0.55 before).

decisions.label: Sparkles: white centres
decisions.note: How far each star's centre goes toward white (0: its colour only, as before).

decisions.label: Sparkles: life (s)
decisions.note: The longest one lasts; each lasts 55% to all of it.

decisions.label: Sparkles: speed
decisions.note: How fast they fly up and out (1: as before).

decisions.label: Sparkles: amber colour (hue)
decisions.note: Two in three sparkles' colour round the colour wheel (0.1 amber); the swatch is the colour.

decisions.label: Sparkles: amber colour (saturation)
decisions.note: 0 white, 1 the hue at its deepest.

decisions.label: Sparkles: rose colour (hue)
decisions.note: The other third's colour (0.93 rose).

decisions.label: Sparkles: rose colour (saturation)
decisions.note: 0 white, 1 the hue at its deepest.

decisions.label: Pillar
decisions.note: The column of party light rising out of her.

decisions.label: Pillar: height (m)
decisions.note: How high its top reaches over her feet (about 14 before, under the crown).

decisions.label: Pillar: width (m)
decisions.note: How wide at its foot; it narrows to about a quarter of that at the top.

decisions.label: Pillar: rise (s)
decisions.note: Seconds to grow from her to its full height (0: at once).

decisions.label: Pillar: duration (s)
decisions.note: How long it lasts (2.4 before); the glow on the floor lasts as long.

decisions.label: Pillar: brightness
decisions.note: 1 full.

decisions.label: Dome
decisions.note: The dome of light round her.

decisions.label: Dome: size
decisions.note: 1: about 8.4 m across, as before.

decisions.label: Dome: duration (s)
decisions.note: 1.8 before.

decisions.label: Dome: fill
decisions.note: How much its inside glows (0: the ring alone, as before).

decisions.label: Light
decisions.note: A real light on everything round her.

decisions.label: Light: reach (m)
decisions.note: 18 before.

decisions.label: Light: strength
decisions.note: At its brightest (0.85 before); it falls away over its last 60%.

decisions.label: Light: duration (s)
decisions.note: Light: duration (s).

decisions.label: Shake
decisions.note: The camera's little shake (never with Reduce flashing).

decisions.label: Shake: amount
decisions.note: 0.18 before.

decisions.label: Shake: duration (s)
decisions.note: Shake: duration (s).

decisions.label: Floor glow
decisions.note: The glow on the floor under her.

decisions.label: Floor glow: brightness
decisions.note: 0.18 before.

decisions.label: Floor glow: size (m)
decisions.note: How wide.

decisions.label: Heat ripple
decisions.note: The picture ripples round her as she casts it. Off: only with ?refraction=1, as before (still a trial, so off as built).
